paragraphs.source_en: “I’ve drunk enough.” The knight shoved his whore aside and got to his feet. His sword belt hung on a peg beside him. He took it down and drew his blade. Steel whispered against leather. The whores were watching avidly, candlelight shining in their eyes. The proprietor had vanished. “You’re mine, Hugor.”

His sword belt hung on a peg beside him.
He took it down and drew his blade.
The whores were watching avidly, candlelight shining in their eyes.

paragraphs.source_en: Tyrion could no more outrun him than outfight him. Drunk as he was, he could not even hope to outwit him. He spread his hands. “And what do you mean to do with me?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Deliver you,” the knight said, “to the queen.”
